center/contain no-repeat}

.upv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}

/* ===== Services page (added) ===== */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* header: same treatment as the homepage header */
.pghead.svh{padding:20px 16px 26px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 18%,rgba(255,212,0,.30),transparent 36%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 88%,rgba(255,255,255,.20),transparent 42%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 2px,transparent 2px 24px),
    linear-gradient(160deg,#1b66f5,#0a3a9c);
  border-bottom:6px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(10,58,156,.35)}
.svh .logo{position:absolute;left:12px;top:14px;width:58px;height:64px}
.svh .hc{padding:0}
.svh .pt{padding:0 62px;font-size:clamp(32px,9vw,46px);letter-spacing:.12em;line-height:1.15;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 35%,#ffe55c 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 #0a3a9c) drop-shadow(0 6px 0 rgba(6,30,100,.55)) drop-shadow(0 10px 12px rgba(0,10,50,.5))}
.svh .ps{padding:0 62px;margin-top:8px;font-weight:600;text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,10,50,.55)}
.sugg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;max-width:760px;margin:16px auto 0}
.sugg span{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,10,50,.55)}
.sugg button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .1s}
.sugg button:hover{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--brand-d)}
.sugg button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
/* service picker: same card style as the ASHS Portal */
button.see{border:0;background:none;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
.svcpick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}
.sp{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:26px 10px 18px;text-align:center;
  font:inherit;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s}
.sp:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.sp b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25}
.sp small{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
.sp .ic{transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.sp .no,.eb{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;background:var(--gold);color:var(--brand-d);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px}
.sp .no{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px}
.sp.on{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,212,0,.6),0 10px 22px rgba(21,83,214,.2)}
.sp.on .ic{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.svcstat{margin:18px 0 0;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand)}
.svcstat:empty{display:none}
.svcnone{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:6px;padding:28px 22px;margin-top:22px;text-align:center}
/* service sections */
.svc{margin-top:34px}
.svchead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.svchead .ic{width:58px;height:58px;flex:none;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--brand-d)}
.svchead .eb{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:4px}
.svchead h2{font-size:20px;line-height:1.2}
.svc>.mute{margin:12px 0 14px}
.cats{display:grid;gap:12px}
/* category cards */
.svc .item{margin:0;transition:box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
.svc .item summary{justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 16px}
.svc .item summary::after{margin-left:auto;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tint);font-size:20px}
.svc .item[open] summary::after{background:var(--gold);color:var(--brand-d)}
.svc .item .ic{width:50px;height:50px;flex:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.svc .item .ic svg{width:25px;height:25px}
.st{display:grid;min-width:0}
.st b{font-size:17px;line-height:1.25}
.st small{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mute)}
.svc .item:hover{border-color:#b7cffa}
.svc .item[open]{border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(21,83,214,.18)}
.svc .item[open] summary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--tint),#fff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc .item[open] .ic{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.svc .grp{padding:16px 18px 6px}
.svc .grp+.grp{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.svc .grp:last-child{padding-bottom:14px}
.svc .grp b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.svc .grp b::before{content:"";flex:none;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand)}
.g-w b::before{background:var(--red)}
.g-a b::before{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,212,0,.35)}
/* option chips */
.svc .chip{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 16px;margin:0 8px 8px 0;border-color:#c7d9fb;
  transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .1s,box-shadow .15s}
.svc .chip:hover{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--brand-d);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.svc .chip:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.svc .chip.sel{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(21,83,214,.35)}
.svc .chip.sel::before{content:"\2713\00a0"}
/* selection bar (above the bottom navigation) */
.selbar{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:calc(86px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:10px 10px 10px 20px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;z-index:5;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--brand),var(--brand-d));box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(10,40,140,.45),0 0 0 3px rgba(255,212,0,.6)}
#services.hasSel .selbar{display:flex}
#services.hasSel main{padding-bottom:110px}
.selbar .si{flex:1;min-width:0;display:grid;line-height:1.25}
.selbar b,.selbar small{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.selbar small{font-size:12px;opacity:.85}
.selbar .go{flex:none;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe24d,#ffc400);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #c99a00;color:var(--brand-d);font:inherit;font-weight:800;padding:10px 20px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .1s,box-shadow .1s}
.selbar .go:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #c99a00}
.selbar .x{flex:none;border:0;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;font-size:20px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
@media (min-width:900px){
  .pghead.svh{padding:44px 40px 52px}
  .svh .logo{left:40px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:140px;height:154px}
  .svh .pt{padding:0 190px;font-size:clamp(60px,7vw,100px);letter-spacing:.14em}
  .svh .ps{padding:0 190px;margin-top:12px;font-size:clamp(18px,1.9vw,26px)}
  .svh .search{margin-top:26px}
  .sugg span,.sugg button{font-size:15px}
  .sugg button{padding:8px 18px}
  main:has(#svcList){max-width:1120px}
  .svcpick{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}
  .sp{padding:44px 18px 32px;gap:10px;border-radius:22px}
  .sp .ic{width:96px;height:96px}.sp .ic svg{width:48px;height:48px}
  .sp b{font-size:21px}.sp small{font-size:16px}
  .sp .no{top:16px;left:16px;font-size:13px;padding:3px 12px}
  .svc{margin-top:52px}
  .svchead{gap:20px}
  .svchead .ic{width:80px;height:80px}.svchead .ic svg{width:40px;height:40px}
  .svchead h2{font-size:30px}
  .svchead .eb{font-size:13px}
  .svc>.mute{font-size:17px;margin:14px 0 20px;max-width:900px}
  .cats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start}
  .svc .item summary{padding:18px 22px;gap:18px}
  .svc .item .ic{width:62px;height:62px}.svc .item .ic svg{width:31px;height:31px}
  .st b{font-size:21px}.st small{font-size:15px}
  .svc .grp{padding:20px 24px 8px}
  .svc .grp:last-child{padding-bottom:18px}
  .svc .chip{font-size:15px;padding:10px 18px}
  .selbar{bottom:96px;padding:12px 12px 12px 28px}
  .selbar b{font-size:18px}.selbar small{font-size:14px}.selbar .go{padding:13px 30px;font-size:16px}
}

/* ==========================================================
   FIXIT – Report an Issue (Students + Teachers)
   Load this AFTER style.css.
   Every rule is scoped to #report, so nothing here can change
   the Home, Services, Activity, Profile or Browse pages.
   ========================================================== */

#report {
  --fx-blue: #1553d6;
  --fx-blue-dark: #0d2f73;
  --fx-navy: #12306b;
  --fx-yellow: #ffd60a;
  --fx-yellow-soft: #fff7cc;
  --fx-card: #ffffff;
  --fx-field: #f4f8ff;
  --fx-line: #c9daf3;
  --fx-text: #2b3a55;
  --fx-muted: #6a7a95;
  --fx-radius: 16px;
  --fx-font: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif;
  --fx-font-display: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
}

#report main {
  font-family: var(--fx-font);
  color: var(--fx-text);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  #report main { max-width: 860px; }
}

#report [hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* inline SVG icons: sized by the font-size of their parent */
#report svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; flex: none; display: block; }

/* Same glowing gold title as the Services page and the F.I.X.I.T word on Home
   (it inherits their size, letter-spacing and 3D shadow). "Report an Issue" is
   longer than a one-word title, so it wraps into two balanced lines when needed. */
#report .svh .pt {
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-wrap: balance;
  background: none;            /* gradient moves to the inner span ... */
  -webkit-background-clip: border-box;
  background-clip: border-box;
  color: #fff;
}

/* ... so EVERY line gets the same white-to-yellow fade as "Services" and
   "F.I.X.I.T" (instead of one colour per line) */
#report .svh .pt__txt {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 35%, #ffe55c 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
  box-decoration-break: clone;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  #report .svh .pt {
    font-size: clamp(52px, 6.2vw, 92px);
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================
   HEADER PROGRESS CHIPS (sits inside the same .pghead.svh
   header used on the Services page)
   ========================================================== */
#report .rsteps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 18px auto 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

#report .rsteps li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 5px 14px 5px 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  border-radius: 999px;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 10, 50, 0.45);
  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
}

#report .rsteps li b {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  border-radius: 50%;
  text-shadow: none;
}

#report .rsteps li.on {
  color: var(--brand-d);
  background: var(--gold);
  border-color: var(--gold);
  text-shadow: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.45);
}

#report .rsteps li.on b { color: #fff; background: var(--brand-d); }

#report .rsteps li.done { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); }
#report .rsteps li.done b { color: var(--brand-d); background: var(--gold); }
#report .rsteps li.done b::before { content: "\2713"; }
#report .rsteps li.done b { font-size: 0; }
#report .rsteps li.done b::before { font-size: 13px; }

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  #report .rsteps { margin-top: 26px; gap: 12px; }
  #report .rsteps li { font-size: 17px; padding: 7px 20px 7px 8px; }
  #report .rsteps li b { width: 30px; height: 30px; font-size: 16px; }
  #report .rsteps li.done b::before { font-size: 16px; }
}

/* ==========================================================
   ISSUE PICKED ON THE SERVICES PAGE ("You're reporting ...")
   ========================================================== */
#report .picked {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 20px 0 0;
  padding: 12px 14px 12px 16px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--fx-blue), #0a3a9c);
  border-radius: var(--fx-radius);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.3);
  animation: fx-rise 0.4s ease both;
}

#report .picked__icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: none;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

#report .picked__text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; line-height: 1.3; }

#report .picked__text small {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

#report .picked__text b { font-size: 1.05rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
#report .picked__text span { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.9; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

#report .picked__change {
  flex: none;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #d9b000;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#report .picked__change:active { transform: translateY(2px); border-bottom-width: 1px; }

/* ==========================================================
   ROLE PICKER (Student / Teacher)
   ========================================================== */
#report .role-intro, #profile .role-intro {
  margin: 24px 0 0;
  text-align: center;
}

#report .role-intro, #profile .role-intro b {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--fx-font-display);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--fx-navy);
}

#report .role-intro, #profile .role-intro span { color: var(--fx-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }

#report .role-pick, #profile .role-pick {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

#report .role-card, #profile .role-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 26px 18px 22px;
  font: inherit;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--fx-text);
  background: var(--fx-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fx-line);
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: var(--fx-radius);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.12);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
}

#report .role-card:hover, #profile .role-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--fx-blue);
  border-bottom-color: var(--fx-yellow);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.2);
}

#report .role-card:active, #profile .role-card:active { transform: translateY(0); }

#report .role-card__icon, #profile .role-card__icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--fx-yellow-soft);
}

#report .role-card__title, #profile .role-card__title {
  font-family: var(--fx-font-display);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-navy);
}

#report .role-card__text, #profile .role-card__text { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--fx-muted); }

#report .role-card__go, #profile .role-card__go {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue);
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  #report .role-pick, #profile .role-pick { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; }
  #report .role-card, #profile .role-card { padding: 34px 22px 28px; }
}

/* ==========================================================
   FORM CARD
   ========================================================== */
#report .report-card {
  position: relative;
  margin: 20px 0 0;
  padding: 1.5rem clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) 2rem;
  background: var(--fx-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fx-line);
  border-left: 6px solid var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: var(--fx-radius);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.16);
  animation: fx-rise 0.5s ease both;
}

#report .report-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 1.5rem;
  width: 90px;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
}

@keyframes fx-rise {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

#report .report__top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  margin: 0 0 0.7rem;
}

#report .report__badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

#report .report__change {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue);
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--fx-line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
}

#report .report__change:hover { background: var(--fx-yellow-soft); border-color: var(--fx-yellow); }

#report .report__title {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
  font-family: var(--fx-font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--fx-navy);
}

#report .report__title::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 64px;
  height: 5px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--fx-blue) 0 60%, var(--fx-yellow) 60%);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* ---------- Form layout ---------- */
#report .report-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: start;
}

#report .field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* wrapper rows flow inside the form grid */
#report .field-row { display: contents; }

#report .field__label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-navy);
}

#report .field__label::before {
  content: "";
  width: 6px;
  height: 1.05em;
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* ---------- Inputs ---------- */
#report .field__control {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 52px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 1rem;               /* 16px stops iOS zoom on focus */
  color: var(--fx-text);
  background: var(--fx-field);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--fx-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.06);
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

#report .field__control::placeholder { color: var(--fx-muted); }

#report .field__control:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--fx-blue);
  background: #fff;
}

#report .field__control:focus {
  outline: none;
  background: #fff;
  border-color: var(--fx-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 214, 10, 0.55), 0 4px 12px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.12);
}

#report .field__control--textarea { min-height: 8rem; resize: vertical; }

#report .field__control:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ---------- Select arrow ---------- */
#report .select-wrap { position: relative; }

#report .select-wrap::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 1.1rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0.5rem;
  height: 0.5rem;
  border-right: 2.5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  border-bottom: 2.5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

#report .select-wrap select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  padding-right: 2.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#report .select-wrap select:required:invalid { color: var(--fx-muted); }
#report .select-wrap select option { color: var(--fx-text); }

/* ---------- Photo upload ---------- */
#report .upload__input {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#report .upload {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  min-height: 64px;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue);
  background: var(--fx-yellow-soft);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 10px, rgba(255, 214, 10, 0.12) 10px 20px);
  border: 2px dashed var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
}

#report .upload:hover {
  background-color: #ffef99;
  border-color: var(--fx-blue);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(255, 214, 10, 0.4);
}

#report .upload__icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 2.6rem;
  height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

#report .upload__input:focus-visible + .upload { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.35); }

/* ---------- Automatic date & time ---------- */
#report .auto-field {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  min-height: 52px;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  color: var(--fx-muted);
  background: #e8f0fc;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--fx-line);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

#report .auto-field__input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--fx-muted);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  cursor: default;
}

#report .auto-field__input:focus { outline: none; }

#report .auto-field__tag {
  padding: 0.1rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

/* ---------- Submit ---------- */
#report .btn-submit {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 56px;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe34d, var(--fx-yellow));
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 4px solid #d9b000;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(255, 214, 10, 0.45);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
}

#report .btn-submit::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -60%;
  width: 40%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  transition: left 0.6s;
}

#report .btn-submit:hover {
  background: #ffe040;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(255, 214, 10, 0.55);
}

#report .btn-submit:hover::after { left: 120%; }
#report .btn-submit:active { transform: translateY(2px); border-bottom-width: 2px; }
#report .btn-submit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--fx-blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

#report .form-message {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow-soft);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

/* ==========================================================
   BUILDING & AREA: one dropdown that drills down
   Building -> Floor -> Area
   ========================================================== */
#report .combo { position: relative; }

#report .combo__button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding-right: 2.6rem;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#report .combo__button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 1.1rem;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0.5rem;
  height: 0.5rem;
  border-right: 2.5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  border-bottom: 2.5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}

#report .combo__button[aria-expanded="true"]::after { transform: translateY(-30%) rotate(-135deg); }

#report .combo__value { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#report .combo__value--placeholder { color: var(--fx-muted); }

/* Type of Problem shows a long path (Category > Issue type > Option), so let it wrap */
#report .combo__value--wrap { white-space: normal; overflow: visible; line-height: 1.3; }
#report .combo__crumb { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

/* invisible input that only powers the "required" check */
#report .combo__validator {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#report .combo__panel {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  max-height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--fx-blue);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(21, 83, 214, 0.22);
}

#report .combo__head {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  background: var(--fx-yellow-soft);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--fx-yellow);
}

#report .combo__back {
  flex: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  background: var(--fx-yellow);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#report .combo__crumb { font-weight: 700; color: var(--fx-navy); font-size: 0.9rem; }

#report .combo__list { margin: 0; padding: 0.35rem; list-style: none; }

#report .combo__item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--fx-text);
  text-align: left;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#report .combo__item:hover,
#report .combo__item:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  background: var(--fx-yellow-soft);
  color: var(--fx-blue-dark);
  font-weight: 700;
}

#report .combo__arrow { font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--fx-blue); }

/* ---------- Tablet / desktop ---------- */
@media (min-width: 760px) {
  #report .report-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.4rem 1.75rem; }

  /* wide items span both columns */
  #report #st-other-field,
  #report #tc-other-field,
  #report .field:has(.upload),
  #report .field:has(.field__control--textarea),
  #report .field:has(.auto-field),
  #report .btn-submit,
  #report .form-message { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  /* Type of Problem always takes the full row */
  #report .field--wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  #report .report__title { font-size: 1.9rem; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #report * { transition: none !important; }
  #report .report-card { animation: none; }
  #report .btn-submit::after { display: none; }
}

/* FIXIT report tracking, roles, dashboards. Uses the site's existing colour variables. */
.fx{padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:110px}
.fx h3{margin:18px 0 8px;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.fx .note{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.fx .box{padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.fx label{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 4px;color:var(--ink)}
.fx input,.fx select,.fx textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.fx .btn{font:700 14px inherit;font-family:inherit;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;margin:8px 8px 0 0}
.fx .btn.alt{background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand-d);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.fx .btn.bad{background:var(--red)}.fx .btn.good{background:#16a34a}.fx .btn.warn{background:#d97706}
.fx .btn[disabled]{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.fx .btn.choice{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:10px 0;padding:14px 16px;font-size:15px}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand-d);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pill.r-admin{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2f00}.pill.r-teacher{background:#dcfce7;color:#14532d}
.pill.bad{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}.pill.ok{background:#dcfce7;color:#14532d}.pill.wait{background:#fef9c3;color:#713f12}
.rc{margin-bottom:12px;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.rc>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rc>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.rc .ti{flex:1 1 200px;min-width:0}.rc .ti b{display:block;color:var(--ink)}.rc .ti small{color:var(--mute)}
.rc .bd{padding:4px 16px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);margin:10px 0}
/* tracker: vertical timeline (works on phones), two-column look on wide screens */
.trk{list-style:none;margin:12px 0;padding:0}
.trk li{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 46px;min-height:34px}
.trk li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:30px;bottom:-2px;width:3px;background:var(--line)}
.trk li:last-child::before{display:none}
.trk li.done::before{background:var(--brand)}
.trk .dot{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--line);color:var(--mute)}
.trk li.done .dot{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.trk li.cur .dot{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(255,212,0,.35);animation:fxp 1.6s infinite}
.trk li.skip .dot{border-style:dashed}.trk li.skip{opacity:.55}
.trk li.rej .dot{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff}
.trk b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px}.trk li.pend b{color:var(--mute);font-weight:600}
.trk small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px}
.trk p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--tint);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px}
@keyframes fxp{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(255,212,0,.12)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.trk li.cur .dot{animation:none}}
@media(min-width:760px){.trk{max-width:640px}}
.msg{border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin:10px 0;font-size:14px}
.msg b{display:block;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px}
.msg.delay{background:#fff1f2;border:1px solid #fecdd3;color:#881337}
.msg.done{background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #bbf7d0;color:#14532d}
.msg.rej{background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;color:#7f1d1d}
.fx .stagebar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:6px 0}
.fx .stagebar .btn{margin:0;padding:7px 12px}.fx .stagebar .btn.on{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
.hist{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);padding-left:18px;margin:6px 0}
.fx .row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.fx .row>*{flex:1 1 140px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:12px 0}
.stats div{padding:12px;text-align:center}.stats b{display:block;font-size:24px;color:var(--brand)}.stats span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
#report .form-message.fx-err{background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;color:#7f1d1d;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px}
#report .form-message.fx-ok{background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #bbf7d0;color:#14532d;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px}
#report .form-message small{display:block;margin-top:6px}
.sess{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px;margin:6px 0 0}


/* ===== Added: login gate, "Not logged in yet" card, reporter summary ===== */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.locked{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px;padding:32px 20px;margin:8px 0 14px}
.locked__ic{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.locked__ic svg{width:30px;height:30px}
.locked b{font-size:18px;color:var(--ink)}
.locked p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;max-width:300px}
.who{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;background:var(--tint);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.who small{color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.who b{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.who span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.role-card--off{opacity:.45}
#report-done{margin-bottom:14px}
.fx .row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}

/* ===== Activity + Profile: same look as Home / Services / Report ===== */
#profile,#activity{  --fx-blue: #1553d6;
  --fx-blue-dark: #0d2f73;
  --fx-navy: #12306b;
  --fx-yellow: #ffd60a;
  --fx-yellow-soft: #fff7cc;
  --fx-card: #ffffff;
  --fx-field: #f4f8ff;
  --fx-line: #c9daf3;
  --fx-text: #2b3a55;
  --fx-muted: #6a7a95;
  --fx-radius: 16px;
  --fx-font: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif;
  --fx-font-display: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
}
.fx{padding-top:20px}
.fx h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:17px;margin:22px 0 10px}
.fx h3::before{content:"";width:8px;height:20px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe24d,#ffc400)}
.fx .box,.fx details.card{border-left:6px solid var(--gold);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(21,83,214,.10)}
.fx .box>b{font-size:17px}
.fx input,.fx select,.fx textarea{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px}
.fx input:focus,.fx select:focus,.fx textarea:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,212,0,.55)}
.fx .btn:not(.alt):not(.bad):not(.good):not(.warn){background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe24d,#ffc400);color:var(--brand-d);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #c99a00}
.fx .btn:not(.alt):not(.bad):not(.good):not(.warn):active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #c99a00}
.fx .note.empty{background:#fff;border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;text-align:center;margin:0 0 10px}
.fx .role-intro{margin:6px 0 14px}
.acct{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.acct__av{flex:none;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:var(--brand-d);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe24d,#ffc400);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #c99a00}
.acct b{font-size:18px}.acct .note{margin:2px 0 0}
.fx .sess{margin:12px 0 4px}

.fx .grpbar small{display:block;color:var(--mute);margin:4px 0 6px;font-size:13px}

/* ===== Account page (logged in) ===== */
.acctcard{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;background:#eef3fc;border:1.5px solid #cfdcf3;border-radius:22px;padding:18px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.acct__av--lg{width:84px;height:84px;font-size:30px;border:4px solid var(--brand);box-shadow:none;background:#dfe6f2;color:var(--brand)}
.acctcard__t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0;align-items:flex-start}
.acctcard__t b{font-size:19px;line-height:1.2}.acctcard__sub{color:var(--brand);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}
.gcard{background:#eef3fc;border:1.5px solid #cfdcf3;border-radius:22px;padding:6px 18px 8px;margin:0 0 14px}
.gcard h4{margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:19px}
.grow{border-top:1px solid #d6e0f2}.gcard h4+.grow{border-top:0}
.grow summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px 0;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.grow summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.grow__ic svg{width:26px;height:26px;display:block;stroke:var(--ink);fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.grow__chev{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;font-size:24px;line-height:1;transition:transform .2s}
.grow[open] .grow__chev{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.grow__body{padding:0 0 14px 40px;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}.grow__body p{margin:0 0 8px}
.logoutwrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:8px 0 24px}
#profile .btn.outl{background:#fff;color:var(--brand);border:2px solid var(--brand);box-shadow:none;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 44px;font-weight:700}
.fx textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:6px 0 10px;font:inherit;resize:vertical}

/* ===== Notification badge ===== */
nav button[data-v="activity"]{position:relative}
.nbadge{position:absolute;top:4px;left:calc(50% + 4px);min-width:19px;height:19px;padding:0 5px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:10px;background:#e11d2e;color:#fff;font:800 11px/15px system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
/* ===== Report cards: clearer details ===== */
.rc .ti{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.rid{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.newtag{align-self:flex-start;background:#e11d2e;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;margin-left:6px}
.rc .ti{position:relative}
.rinfo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;background:#f6f9ff;border:1px solid #dbe5f7;border-radius:16px;padding:6px 14px;margin:12px 0}
.irow{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid #e3ebf8}.irow:first-child{border-top:0}
.irow__ic{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe5f7;display:grid;place-items:center}
.irow__ic svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:var(--brand);fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.irow__t{min-width:0;flex:1}.irow__t small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:2px}
.irow__t>div{color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;word-break:break-word}.irow__sub{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px}
.crumb{display:inline-block;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfdcf3;color:var(--brand);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin:2px 0}
.crumb__sep{font-style:normal;color:var(--mute);margin:0 5px}
.msg.fixed{background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;color:#1e3a8a}
.areview{background:#fffbea;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:6px solid #ffc400;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin:12px 0}
.areview b{display:block;font-size:15px}.areview small{display:block;color:var(--mute);margin:3px 0 8px}

/* ===== Progress meter + timeline ===== */
.pmeter{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f9ff,#eef4ff);border:1px solid #dbe5f7;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;margin:12px 0 6px}
.pmeter__top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:14px}
.pmeter__top b{color:var(--ink)}.pmeter__top span{color:var(--brand);font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.pmeter__bar{height:12px;border-radius:999px;background:#dbe5f7;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
.pmeter__bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1553d6,#4f8cff 65%,#ffd60a);transition:width .6s ease}
.pmeter.done .pmeter__bar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#16a34a,#4ade80)}
.pmeter.late .pmeter__bar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#fbbf24)}
.pmeter.rej .pmeter__bar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#dc2626,#f87171)}
.pmeter.done .pmeter__top span{color:#15803d}.pmeter.rej .pmeter__top span{color:#dc2626}
.trk{margin:14px 0 6px}
.trk li{padding:0 0 12px 56px;min-height:40px}
.trk li::before{left:18px;top:42px;bottom:-4px;width:4px;border-radius:2px;background:#dbe5f7}
.trk li.done::before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1553d6,#4f8cff)}
.trk .dot{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(21,83,214,.12)}
.trk li.done .dot{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2f6df0,#1553d6);border-color:#1553d6;font-size:17px}
.trk__c{border-radius:14px;padding:8px 2px 2px}
.trk li.done .trk__c b{color:var(--brand)}
.trk li.cur .trk__c{background:#fffbea;border:1px solid #fde68a;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,196,0,.18)}
.trk li.cur.rej .trk__c{background:#fef2f2;border-color:#fecaca;box-shadow:none}
.trk li.cur .trk__c p{background:#fff;border:1px solid #fde68a}
.trk li.pend .dot{background:#f1f5fb;color:#94a3b8}
/* ===== History ===== */
.hist2{margin:16px 0 4px}
.hist2 h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.hist2 h4::before{content:"";width:6px;height:18px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe24d,#ffc400)}
.hist2 ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.hi{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;padding:0 0 10px}
.hi::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:20px;bottom:-2px;width:2px;background:#dbe5f7}.hi:last-child::before{display:none}
.hi__dot{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid #94a3b8;margin-top:8px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hi--student .hi__dot{border-color:#1553d6}.hi--teacher .hi__dot{border-color:#16a34a}.hi--admin .hi__dot{border-color:#d97706}
.hi__b{flex:1;min-width:0;background:#f6f9ff;border:1px solid #e0e9f8;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px}
.hi__b b{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
.hi__b p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:#334155;word-break:break-word}
.hi__b small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px}
.hi__b em{font-style:normal;text-transform:capitalize;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand)}

/* admin: manage site content */
.chead{margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:var(--brand-d)}
.crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 10px;margin:6px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}
.crow.on{border-color:var(--brand);background:var(--tint)}
.crow .cinfo{flex:1 1 160px;min-width:0}.crow .cinfo b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px}.crow .cinfo small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.crow .btn{margin:0;padding:6px 12px}
.cprev{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0}.cprev img{width:96px;height:64px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
#c-go,#c-cancel{margin-top:10px}

/* ===== v11: Grand Project default, event details popup, Activity title buttons, Profile role row ===== */
.slide--default figcaption small{opacity:.9}
.evc{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.evc:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(21,83,214,.16)}
.evc:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:2px}
.evc__more{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand)}
.evm{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2100;background:rgba(15,42,92,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;overflow-y:auto}
.evm[hidden]{display:none!important}
.evm__box{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.evm__x{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:2;width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(15,42,92,.75);color:#fff;font-size:24px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
#evm-img .ph{height:220px;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.evm__b{padding:18px 20px 22px}
.evm__b em{display:inline-block;font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--brand);background:var(--tint);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.evm__b h3{margin:10px 0 4px;font-size:22px;color:var(--ink)}
.evm__meta{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:600}
.evm__desc{margin:0;white-space:pre-line;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.evm__desc.is-empty{color:var(--mute);font-style:italic}
/* Activity: every block is a titled button */
.asec{margin:14px 0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.asec>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);border-left:6px solid var(--gold)}
.asec>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.asec>summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:-3px}
.asec__t{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.asec__n{flex:none;min-width:26px;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand);font-size:13px;text-align:center}
.asec__chev{flex:none;font-style:normal;font-size:24px;line-height:1;color:var(--brand);transition:transform .2s}
.asec[open]>summary .asec__chev{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.asec[open]>summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.asec__b{padding:6px 14px 14px}
.asec__b .rc{margin-top:12px}
.asec__b .stats{margin-top:8px}
.asec__b .note.empty{margin:10px 0 0}
/* Profile: Student | Teacher on top, Admin centred under them */
#profile .role-pick > :nth-child(3):last-child{grid-column:1 / -1;justify-self:center;width:calc(50% - 10px)}
@media (max-width:599px){#profile .role-pick > :nth-child(3):last-child{width:100%}}

/* ===== Academic Guide page (added) ===== */
#acad main{padding-bottom:30px}
.actabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.actabs button{font:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;padding:12px 22px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand-d);cursor:pointer}
.actabs button.on{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.acpane{display:none}
.acpane.on{display:block}
.acpane h2.lg{margin-top:30px;font-size:26px}
.acsub{margin:12px 0 18px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--mute)}
.encols{display:grid;gap:18px;align-items:start}
.enc,.bld{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.enc h3,.bld h3{margin:0;padding:18px 20px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--brand),var(--brand-d));border-bottom:4px solid var(--gold)}
.enc h3{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;color:var(--gold)}
.enc ol{list-style:none;counter-reset:st;margin:0;padding:18px 20px 8px}
.enc li{counter-increment:st;position:relative;padding:4px 0 14px 46px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink);min-height:40px}
.enc li::before{content:counter(st);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.imp{margin:6px 20px 20px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff3c4}
.imp b{display:block;font-size:17px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.imp p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--mute)}
.bldgrid{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:16px;align-items:start}
.bld h3{font-size:22px}
.bbody{padding:6px 20px 14px}
.fl{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fl:first-child{border-top:0}
.fl h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand)}
.fl ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
.fl li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.rm{flex:none;min-width:46px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.rm.gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
.rm.blue{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.acnone{margin:20px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--mute)}
.acfoot{margin:22px 0 0;padding-left:14px;border-left:3px solid var(--brand-d);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;color:var(--brand-d)}
@media (min-width:700px){
  .encols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .bldgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
}
@media (min-width:900px){
  .acpane h2.lg{font-size:30px;margin-top:36px}
  .acsub{font-size:16px}
  .actabs{padding:18px 22px}
  .actabs button{font-size:17px;padding:13px 28px}
  .enc h3{font-size:20px;padding:22px 22px}
  .enc li{font-size:17px}
  .bld h3{font-size:22px}
  .fl li{font-size:17px}
  .rm{font-size:14px}
}

/* ===== ASHS Portal pages and admin editor (added) ===== */
.encols.one{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;max-width:760px}
.orgh{margin-top:30px}
.org{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:34px;margin:22px 0 10px}
.orgrow{position:relative;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:16px;width:100%}
.orgrow + .orgrow::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-34px;height:34px;border-left:3px solid var(--line)}
.orgcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:220px;max-width:100%;padding:18px 14px;text-align:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.orgav{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3b82f6,var(--brand-d))}
.orgcard b{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25}
.orgcard small{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.35}
.pa-form{margin:12px 0;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--tint)}
.pa-form textarea,.pa-form input,.pa-form select{width:100%}
.pa-card{margin:12px 0;padding:12px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.pa-card .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.crow .btn[disabled]{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
@media (min-width:900px){.orgcard{width:250px}.orgcard b{font-size:19px}}

/* ===== ASHS Portal: admin hub, Academic Guide editor, organizational chart ===== */
.pa-hub{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));margin:12px 0 6px}
.fx .pa-opt,.fx .pa-method{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:6px solid var(--gold);border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.fx .pa-opt:hover,.fx .pa-method:hover{border-color:var(--brand)}
.fx .pa-opt svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--brand)}
.fx .pa-opt b,.fx .pa-method b{font-size:16px;line-height:1.25}
.fx .pa-opt small,.fx .pa-method small{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}
.fx .pa-back{margin:0 0 6px}
.pa-methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}
.fx .pa-method.on{border-color:var(--brand);background:var(--tint)}
.pa-live{margin-top:2px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#16a34a;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.pa-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
.pa-head b{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.pa-badge{padding:3px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--brand-d);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.pa-group{margin:12px 0;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.pa-group>h5{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.pa-form label{display:block;margin:10px 0 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.pa-form input,.pa-form textarea,.pa-form select{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%}
.pa-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:6px 0}
.pa-line input{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;width:auto}
.pa-line .pa-rt{flex:0 0 84px;width:84px}
.pa-sp{flex:1}
.pa-num{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand-d);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.pa-x{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--red);font-size:18px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.pa-x:hover{background:#fff1f2}
.pa-sub{margin:10px 0;padding:10px;border-left:4px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--tint)}
.pa-save{margin-top:14px}
.pa-card .pa-line .btn{margin:0;padding:6px 12px}
.pa-photo{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0}
.pa-av{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:var(--tint)}
.pa-av.big{width:84px;height:84px;font-size:26px}
.pa-av.oini{display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3b82f6,var(--brand-d))}
.pa-av.big.oini{font-size:26px}
.pa-pr .cinfo b,.pa-pr .cinfo small{white-space:normal}
.pa-thumb{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:280px;margin:6px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}
@media(max-width:560px){.pa-methods{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* public organizational chart */
.oscroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;margin:18px 0 6px;padding:22px 10px 14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.otree{--cw:176px;--g:22px;--ln:#8fa9dd;width:max-content;min-width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.otree ul{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:0;padding:var(--g) 0 0;list-style:none}
.otree li{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:var(--g) 7px 0;list-style:none}
.otree li::before,.otree li::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:50%;width:50%;height:var(--g);border-top:3px solid var(--ln)}
.otree li::after{right:auto;left:50%;border-left:3px solid var(--ln)}
.otree li:only-child{padding-top:0}
.otree li:only-child::before,.otree li:only-child::after{display:none}
.otree li:first-child::before,.otree li:last-child::after{border:0 none}
.otree li:last-child::before{border-right:3px solid var(--ln);border-radius:0 8px 0 0}
.otree li:first-child::after{border-radius:8px 0 0 0}
.otree ul ul::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;height:var(--g);border-left:3px solid var(--ln)}
.otree ul.oroot{padding-top:0;align-items:flex-start}
.otree ul.oroot>li{padding-top:0}
.otree ul.oroot>li::before,.otree ul.oroot>li::after{display:none}
.ocard{box-sizing:border-box;width:var(--cw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:12px 10px 13px;text-align:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.ocard.d0{border-top-color:var(--red)}.ocard.d1{border-top-color:var(--brand)}.ocard.d2{border-top-color:var(--gold)}.ocard.d3{border-top-color:#16a34a}.ocard.d4{border-top-color:#7c3aed}
.oph{width:66px;height:66px;margin-bottom:4px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid var(--tint);background:var(--tint)}
.oini{display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:21px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3b82f6,var(--brand-d))}
.ocard b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ocard small{font-size:12px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--mute);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
/* a long team of people with no team of their own hangs in one tidy column under their head */
.otree li.hang{align-items:flex-start;padding-left:calc(var(--cw)/2 + 23.5px);padding-right:0}
.otree li.hang>.ocard{align-self:flex-start}
.otree ul.ohang{display:block;align-self:flex-start;margin-left:calc(var(--cw)/2 - 1.5px);padding:0 0 0 25px}
.otree ul.ohang::before{display:none}
.otree ul.ohang>li{display:block;padding:14px 0 0}
.otree ul.ohang>li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-25px;right:auto;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:auto;border:0;border-left:3px solid var(--ln);border-radius:0}
.otree ul.ohang>li:last-child::before{bottom:auto;height:calc(14px + (100% - 14px)/2)}
.otree ul.ohang>li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-25px;right:auto;top:calc(14px + (100% - 14px)/2);width:22px;height:0;border:0;border-top:3px solid var(--ln);border-radius:0}
.orghint{display:none;margin:4px 2px 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.orgfile{margin:18px 0 6px;padding:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--shadow);text-align:center}
.orgfile img{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:0 auto;border-radius:10px}
.orgfile figcaption,.orgopen{margin:8px 0 2px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.orgfile object{display:block;width:100%;height:min(80vh,900px);border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--tint)}
.orgopen a{display:inline-block;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
@media(max-width:900px){.orghint{display:block}}
@media(max-width:560px){.otree{--cw:148px;--g:18px}.ocard{padding:10px 8px 11px}.oph{width:56px;height:56px}.oini{font-size:18px}.oscroll{padding:18px 6px 12px}}

/* ===== Admin polish: Manage ASHS Portal hub + Manage Site Content tabs (added) ===== */
.pa-intro h4{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.pa-intro .note{margin:2px 0 6px}
.pa-hub{display:grid;gap:14px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));margin:12px 0 6px}
.fx .pa-opt{--ac:#1553d6;--acbg:#e6eeff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:14px;padding:18px 18px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--ac);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,42,92,.07);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s}
.fx .pa-opt.pa-sbms{--ac:#0f9d8a;--acbg:#e0f6f2}
.fx .pa-opt.pa-persons{--ac:#8b5cf6;--acbg:#f0eaff}
.fx .pa-opt:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(15,42,92,.14);border-color:var(--ac)}
.fx .pa-opt:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-ico{display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--acbg);color:var(--ac)}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-ico svg{width:26px;height:26px;color:inherit}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex:1}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-txt b{font-size:17px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink)}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-txt small{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--mute)}
.fx .pa-opt .pa-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.pa-pill{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b}
.pa-pill.ok{background:var(--acbg,#e6f6ec);color:var(--ac,#15803d)}
.pa-go{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ac);transition:transform .15s}
.fx .pa-opt:hover .pa-go{transform:translateX(4px)}
.fx .pa-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:13px}
/* Manage Site Content: category tabs */
.ctabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0 10px;padding:6px;background:var(--tint);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px}
.fx .ctab{flex:1 1 120px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:10px 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:var(--brand-d);font:700 14px/1.2 inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.fx .ctab:hover{background:#fff}
.fx .ctab.on{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(21,83,214,.18),inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold)}
.ctab .cnt{min-width:22px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-size:12px}
.ctab:not(.on) .cnt{background:#c7d6f5;color:var(--brand-d)}
.cpanel{min-height:60px}
.cthumb{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:var(--tint)}
.cthumb.none{display:inline-block;border:1px dashed var(--line)}
.crow .cbtns{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-left:auto}
.fx .crow .cbtns .btn{margin:0;padding:7px 14px}

/* ===== Report tabs (Admin / Teacher / Student) (added) ===== */
.ctabs.rt{margin:12px 0 12px;gap:6px}
.fx .ctabs.rt .ctab{flex:1 1 96px;padding:9px 8px;font-size:13px}
.fx .ctab.alert:not(.on){background:#fff4f4;color:var(--red)}
.ctab.alert .cnt{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
@media(max-width:560px){.ctabs.rt .ctab{flex:1 1 44%}}

/* ===== Awaiting adviser: display-only counter (added) ===== */
.await{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:10px 0 4px;padding:6px 12px;background:#fff8dc;border:1px solid #f1d977;border-left:5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;cursor:default;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.await__t{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.await__t b{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink)}
.await__t small{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute)}
.await__n{min-width:30px;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;text-align:center}
/* Admin report tabs: equal-size buttons in a tidy grid */
.ctabs.rt3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.fx .ctabs.rt3 .ctab{flex:none;min-height:46px;padding:6px 8px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;line-height:1.15;text-align:center}
@media(min-width:700px){.ctabs.rt3{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}.fx .ctabs.rt3 .ctab{flex-direction:row;gap:6px}}
/* Grand Project: default picture */
.slide--default{height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.slide--default img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.grand-default .garr,.grand-default .dots{display:none}
/* Profile: the account card opens "My profile" (added) */
.acctcard[data-act]{cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.acctcard[data-act]:hover{border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(21,83,214,.12)}
.acctcard[data-act]:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.acctcard[data-act]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.acctcard__edit{margin-left:auto;flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;color:var(--brand);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.acctcard__edit svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.pfov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2100;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:rgba(10,20,40,.55)}
.pfbox{width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:92vh;max-height:92dvh;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--bg,#fff);border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
.pfhead{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 18px 12px;background:var(--bg,#fff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.pfhead h3{margin:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink)}
.pfclose{width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tint);color:var(--brand-d);font-size:24px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.pfov .pfbody.fx{padding:6px 18px 22px}
.pfov input[readonly]{background:var(--tint);color:var(--mute)}
.pfpw{margin:14px 0 4px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 14px 12px;background:#fff}
.pfpw summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;padding:10px 0;color:var(--brand-d)}
.pferr{color:var(--red);min-height:1.2em;font-weight:600}
@media (min-width:700px){.pfov{align-items:center}.pfbox{border-radius:22px;max-height:88vh}}
